instruction: In apps/daemon/src/machine-loop.ts and apps/daemon/src/computer/presence.ts, runtime, install, and phone callbacks trigger presence announcements without handling rejected fetches, so when the server is unreachable an unhandled rejection exits the daemon. Route those callbacks through a fire-and-forget ComputerPresenceReporter.notify() helper that skips when closed and forwards errors to onError so the Runner stays alive offline.
